title: Trombonist Eddie Benson of Algiers
summary: Russell asks about Eddie Benson; Love says he first heard him practicing while working at the Navy Yard.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: The last interview we had a month ago, you were telling about the trombone players like Eddie Benson over in Algiers. Could you tell us some more about him when you first met him?
When I first met him, I was working at the Navy Yard and I used to hear them fellas practicing over there.
